analysis: The trial executed successfully but did not improve validation HR@10: macro score was 0.5125, down 0.0075 from the stated parent score of 0.52 and 0.0187 below the referenced best of 0.5312. Category HR@10 was Movies_and_TV 0.525, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.57, Electronics 0.425, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.53. Movies remained at 0.525, so the intended recovery of persistent preferences was not observed. The gated history residual did not help aggregate performance in this run; these results alone do not establish whether pooling, optimization, or checkpoint selection caused the regression. Hidden test performance was not assessed.
code_summary: Trained one independent ConvRec per category, with exactly one selected checkpoint loaded for each route. The backbone uses 96-dimensional tied item embeddings, learned item biases, eight causal residual convolution blocks with dilations (1,2,4,8,1,2,4,8), and two-head attention with learned relative-distance bias. Added an undropped causal prefix mean of item embeddings, a bias-free projection, and a featurewise sigmoid gate initialized with zero weights and bias -3; the gated residual enters before final LayerNorm. Retained 512-negative cross-entropy normalized per history, AdamW, cosine learning-rate decay, seed 42, and validation HR@10 checkpoint selection with NDCG tie-breaking and 25-epoch patience. Predictor reconstructs the same architecture and strictly loads its complete checkpoint. Added checks for prefix pooling, finite gradients, padding, causality, and checkpoint reload parity.
